svg.title: Finding the files a fix changes: 100 SWE-bench Verified issues, held out from tuning. Top 1: Graphicle 0.1.3 43, Graphicle 0.1.2 13, BM25 (SWE-bench style) 35, grep for the issue's names 20; Top 5: Graphicle 0.1.3 75, Graphicle 0.1.2 30, BM25 (SWE-bench style) 61, grep for the issue's names 54; Top 10: Graphicle 0.1.3 82, Graphicle 0.1.2 30, BM25 (SWE-bench style) 77, grep for the issue's names 71; MRR: Graphicle 0.1.3 0.562, Graphicle 0.1.2 0.191, BM25 (SWE-bench style) 0.478, grep for the issue's names 0.365.
svg.desc: Finding the files a fix changes: 100 SWE-bench Verified issues, held out from tuning. For each issue: is a file the fix changed among the first k files? Graphicle: the files its context packet cites, then lists. No model calls. Higher is better. Top 1 (Issues of 100 with a changed file first): Graphicle 0.1.3 43, Graphicle 0.1.2 13, BM25 (SWE-bench style) 35, grep for the issue's names 20; 0.1.3 vs BM25, McNemar exact: +8 issues, p = 0.200, not significant. Top 5 (Issues of 100 with a changed file in the first 5): Graphicle 0.1.3 75, Graphicle 0.1.2 30, BM25 (SWE-bench style) 61, grep for the issue's names 54; 0.1.3 vs BM25, McNemar exact: +14 issues, p = 0.013. Top 10 (Issues of 100 with a changed file in the first 10): Graphicle 0.1.3 82, Graphicle 0.1.2 30, BM25 (SWE-bench style) 77, grep for the issue's names 71; 0.1.3 vs BM25, McNemar exact: +5 issues, p = 0.383, not significant. MRR (Mean reciprocal rank of the first changed file): Graphicle 0.1.3 0.562, Graphicle 0.1.2 0.191, BM25 (SWE-bench style) 0.478, grep for the issue's names 0.365. Graphicle 0.1.3 and the 0.1.2 release binary run graphicle context on the issue's prompt, with their defaults. BM25: SWE-bench style, one document per source file. grep: rg 14.1.1 for the identifiers and paths the issue names, files ranked by names matched. This measures ranking, not whether a coding agent fixes more issues. The agent test of 0.1.3 is pending. Method, task list and limits: github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/retrieval.md
